source.title: Phase-type distributions: Open problems and a few properties

trace.notes: Normalized the input as a zbMATH bibliographic resolver URL with trailing identifier 1347398.

Failure mode: network_or_dns_failure for local shell resolution, plus metadata_only for the available zbMATH resolver path. The zbMATH landing URL did not yield a readable full-text artifact through the available page reader. Local shell fetches of zbmath.org and api.zbmath.org failed with DNS resolution errors in the sandbox, so direct local resolver, API, HTML, and PDF downloads could not be completed.

Local workflow metadata for the same source records the title, year 1999, and the DOI 10.1080/15326349908807560. This metadata was used only for source identity and title recovery, not for question extraction.

Failure modes: blocked_or_challenged or paywalled_or_restricted for the publisher and DeepDyve candidates; metadata_only for the University of Queensland abstract page and related citation pages. Ran exact-work recovery attempts using the exact title, DOI 10.1080/15326349908807560, and the zbMATH identifier. The Taylor & Francis DOI landing page and journal issue page exposed only abstract or access-link metadata through the available reader. The University of Queensland page contained only an abstract and author metadata. The DeepDyve candidate advertised full text behind an access flow. Related citing pages and secondary references were rejected because they did not contain the primary technical problem statements.

No candidates were mapped, extracted, rewritten, or accepted because no readable full-text artifact could be confirmed and accessed as the same exact zbMATH source. The workflow forbids extracting questions from resolver metadata, abstracts, citation pages, search snippets, paywalled pages, or related works.
Saved final JSON to outputs/parse-paper/1347398.json and outputs/latest.json.
